# SIERRA PACIFIC WINDOWS DH CONFIGURATION - COMPREHENSIVE RESEARCH FINDINGS

## PRODUCT OVERVIEW

- **Manufacturer:** Sierra Pacific Windows, division of Sierra Pacific Industries
- **Material Class:** Multiple product lines available: 
H3 Fusion Technology (wood/vinyl/aluminum composite), Premium Aluminum Clad Wood (Westchester, Monument, Transcend), All-Wood, and Vinyl (8000/8500 series)

- **Configuration Type:** 
DH refers to Double Hung windows, available across multiple product lines including H3 Fusion Tech Series which features both sashes that operate so you can control ventilation from the top and bottom of the window

- **Country of Origin:** United States (California, Wisconsin, and Alabama manufacturing facilities)
- **Parent Company:** 
Sierra Pacific Windows is part of Sierra Pacific Industries, which sustainably manages over 2.4 million acres of timberland in California, Oregon, and Washington

 across all major product lines.

Although more expensive to manufacture, all our clad color collections are AAMA 2604 or AAMA 2605 powder coated for greater surface hardness, scratch resistance and color retention, than ordinary liquid paint


### Glazing Options


Sierra Pacific offers the most advanced glazing options in the industry, including dual and triple pane, and double or triple low-E coatings


### Hardware Features


Sierra Pacific features an easy to use lever-action lock that engages smoothly and securely. Easy-tilt latches simplify your window cleaning process, just tilt the sash inward and you can clean the exterior surface without having to step outside


### Construction Details


Sierra Pacific's aluminum-clad windows are fully encased in a .05" of extruded aluminum, making them twice as thick as the competition. This added thickness translates to tougher, stronger, more durable, and more dent-resistant windows


**WARRANTY TERMS:** 
Sierra Pacific offers a limited warranty that is fully transferable and includes a 2-year labor coverage and 10-year parts coverage for manufacturing defects. For their AAMA 2065 clad exterior coating, they offer a 30-year residential coverage. They also provide a 20-year warranty on their insulated glass

### Green Building Advisor (High-Authority Building Science Community)

**Professional Assessment - Current Recommendation:** 
Marvin Elevate is my second choice for North American-style, mid-budget windows but SP's H3 line is superior in my opinion



My current go-to for North American-style triple-glazed windows is Sierra Pacific, specifically their H3 line. I have found them to be high quality and a good value. I have installed one in my own house, three in my mom's house and a bunch in my mother-in-law's house


**H3 Double Hung Specific Experience:** 
On an addition for my MIL's house we used triple glazed Sierra Pacific H3 double-hung windows; they have a composite exterior, wood interior, look good, perform well and were reasonably priced


**Double Hung Operation Issues:** 
The only complaints I've heard are from an older person who finds it hard to lift the heavy double-hung sashes; the counterweight springs could be a little tighter. She also finds that locking the double-hung sashes is more finicky than with the ancient Andersons in the rest of her house


**Mixed Opinions:** 
I'm also looking at the Sierra Pacific H3 series. Aluminum clad vinyl, with wood casing. I also read a lot of terrible reviews about Sierra pacific but then some builders say theyre a great value
